**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Fence saves with the configuration path**

If the active runtime-config path changes after the draft is read but before `s` is pressed—for example, after a same-workspace server restart—and the new file initially has identical text, this write carries only the old content revision. `Runtime.config_observation` hashes only `source_text`, and `post_runtime_config_raw` likewise sends no expected path, so the server CAS succeeds and writes the draft to the newly selected file despite the UI contract requiring the operator to discard a changed-path draft. Include and validate the expected source path in the guarded save request so a path switch becomes a conflict even when the contents match.
